snippet.title: Endless Rails - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Endless Rails on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4601120/Endless_Rails/

Command a fleet of auto-shooting drones to defend your train as it rolls deeper into a monster-infested wasteland. Bolt weapons onto your cars, merge and upgrade them between stations, and keep the rails clear. The further you push, the harder the wasteland pushes back.

#indiegame #bullethell #isometric #roguelite
